content.value: Suppose that a 32 bit microprocessor is feeding with 3 GHz clock generator. On an average, (08) 20 cycles are required to complete and instruction.
i) Determine processor speed in terms of instruction/sec.
ii) How long it would take to execute 64 KB of code if average instruction size is 32 bit?
